# Vendored packages

`fairdatateam-record-core-0.2.0.tgz` is `npm pack` of `packages/record-core` in
luizbonino/Contour at commit c273c9d (PR #29). It is vendored only until
`@fairdatateam/record-core` is published on npm (needs the npm organisation
`fairdatateam`); then `package.json` switches to the registry version and
this file is deleted.
